record.question: Which state has recently banned "rat-hole coal mining" in compliance of the order of the National Green Tribunal?
record.explanation: Answer D: Meghalaya. Meghalaya was the state subject to the National Green Tribunal's 17 April 2014 direction to stop rat-hole mining. The tribunal's later order reproduces that original direction and identifies the state. Historical/source note: Historical 2014 judicial restriction on rat-hole mining in Meghalaya; not a claim about current permitted mining methods. Reference: https://www.greentribunal.gov.in/sites/default/files/news_updates/Affidavit%20filed%20by%20R-1%20in%20OA%20154%20of%202023%20%28EZ%29.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
